description: Move a previously fixed/verified/dismissed report back to the reopened state for regression review, recording an operator note. Returns { report } with status=reopened. Write; idempotent — reopening an already-reopened report is a no-op. Use when a reporter says "still broken" after a fix shipped; use transition_status for any other state change.

note.description: Operator note recorded on the reopen transition

reportId.description: Report UUID to move back to reopened status (`report_id` is accepted too.)

name: reopen_report
title: Reopen report (operator)
